# Judge blocks Trump administration from cutting down trees at D.C. golf course for 2 weeks

October 13, 2026 / 1:34 PM EDT
/ CBS News

Washington — A federal judge on Tuesday barred the Trump administration from removing trees at East Potomac Golf Links in Washington, D.C., for another two weeks after hundreds of trees were felled at the historic public course over the weekend.
